subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**away**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses selecting the correct preposition to fit the context.
 
• The appropriate preposition should fit grammatically and contextually within the sentence.
 
• "**Away**" fits well as it indicates movement or distance, which aligns with the context of the sentence.
 
• Other options ("**through**", "**on**", "**by**") do not fit as appropriately in the given context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Through: Indicates movement in one side and out of the other side, which does not fit the context here.
 
• On: Indicates a position above or in contact with, which does not fit the context here.
 
• By: Indicates the agent performing an action, which does not fit the context here.
